root_cause.text: In ASoC SOF IPC4 bytes-control loading, `sof_ipc4_control_load_bytes()` misinterpreted topology `max_size` as including `struct sof_ipc4_control_data` even though it only covers `struct sof_abi_hdr + payload`, causing under-allocation of `scontrol->ipc_control_data`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that the real buffer size is `sizeof(struct sof_ipc4_control_data) + sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr) + payload` while `max_size` only specifies `sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr) + payload`, and the patch changes `kzalloc(scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL)` to `kzalloc(sizeof(*control_data) + scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL)` and updates the size checks accordingly.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In ASoC SOF IPC4 bytes-control loading, `sof_ipc4_control_load_bytes()` misinterpreted topology `max_size` as including `struct sof_ipc4_control_data` even though it only covers `struct sof_abi_hdr + payload`, causing under-allocation of `scontrol->ipc_control_data`.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit message explicitly states that the real buffer size is `sizeof(struct sof_ipc4_control_data) + sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr) + payload` while `max_size` only specifies `sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr) + payload`, and the patch changes `kzalloc(scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL)` to `kzalloc(sizeof(*control_data) + scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL)` and updates the size checks accordingly.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix IPC4 bytes control sizing by validating max_size and priv_size against ABI payload semantics and allocating space for both the local control structure and maximum payload.
intent_record.what: The code changes the size validation logic in sof_ipc4_control_load_bytes(): it replaces a check that required max_size to be at least sizeof(struct sof_ipc4_control_data) + sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr) with a check that max_size is at least sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr); replaces a check comparing priv_size against max_size - sizeof(struct sof_ipc4_control_data) with a direct priv_size > max_size check; adds a new check rejecting priv_size values smaller than sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr); updates scontrol->size assignment to use sizeof(*control_data) + priv_size; changes the kzalloc() size from scontrol->max_size to sizeof(*control_data) + scontrol->max_size; and adds explanatory comments plus adjusted error messages.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now interprets max_size as the topology-provided limit for only the ABI header plus payload, not including the local sof_ipc4_control_data wrapper. This prevents valid controls from being rejected due to subtracting the local struct from max_size, ensures the initial private data is both large enough to contain an ABI header and not larger than the allowed payload area, and allocates enough memory for both the local control_data structure and the full maximum control payload, avoiding undersized allocation and inconsistent size validation.

grouping_result.intent: Fix IPC4 bytes control sizing by validating max_size and priv_size against ABI payload semantics and allocating space for both the local control structure and maximum payload.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the IPC4 bytes-control size interpretation bug by treating max_size/priv_size according to ABI payload semantics and allocating enough memory for both struct sof_ipc4_control_data and the maximum payload, which matches the stated under-allocation root cause.

candidates.rationale: This is the direct under-allocation bug: it allocates only max_size, but max_size represents ABI header plus payload and does not include the enclosing struct sof_ipc4_control_data needed for the local buffer.
This validation embodies the same semantic mistake by treating max_size as if it must include sizeof(*control_data), reinforcing the incorrect interpretation that later leads to under-allocation.

This size check subtracts the local control_data structure from max_size, misinterpreting max_size as including that structure rather than only ABI header plus payload, which is the root cause described.

This computes the true in-memory size needed for the local control structure plus payload, highlighting the mismatch with the subsequent allocation that uses only max_size. While not itself faulty, it is directly part of the size inconsistency causing the bug.

vuln_statements.explanation: This allocation uses scontrol->max_size as the total buffer size even though max_size only represents struct sof_abi_hdr plus payload from topology data, not the enclosing struct sof_ipc4_control_data. As a result, scontrol->ipc_control_data is under-allocated, which is the core root cause.

This bounds check subtracts sizeof(*control_data) from max_size, reflecting the incorrect assumption that max_size includes the local struct sof_ipc4_control_data. That semantic error directly contributes to the later under-allocation.

This validation also misinterprets max_size as needing to cover sizeof(*control_data) in addition to the ABI header, even though max_size is defined only for struct sof_abi_hdr plus payload. It encodes the faulty sizing model behind the vulnerability.

bic_trace_step.reason: The added function `sof_ipc4_control_load_bytes()` contains the vulnerable size interpretation directly, so the snippet is sufficient. The root cause is present because the code treats `scontrol->max_size` as if it includes `struct sof_ipc4_control_data`. Specifically, it rejects sizes smaller than `sizeof(*control_data) + sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr)` via `if (scontrol->max_size < (sizeof(*control_data) + sizeof(struct sof_abi_hdr)))`, and later compares payload size against `scontrol->max_size - sizeof(*control_data)` via `if (scontrol->priv_size > scontrol->max_size - sizeof(*control_data))`. Most importantly, allocation is done as `scontrol->ipc_control_data = kzalloc(scontrol->max_size, GFP_KERNEL);` while the code later uses the buffer as a full `struct sof_ipc4_control_data` plus copied byte data (`memcpy(control_data->data, scontrol->priv, scontrol->priv_size)`). Per the stated root cause, topology `max_size` only covers `struct sof_abi_hdr + payload`, not the enclosing `struct sof_ipc4_control_data`, so allocating only `max_size` under-allocates `ipc_control_data`. There is no corrective adjustment such as allocating `sizeof(struct sof_ipc4_control_data) + max_size` or otherwise separating the meanings of `max_size`, so the fix is not present.
